main.description: One image. By default an avatar; see purpose for gallery images. The blob holds the full original (long edge up to 4096 pixels). The optional crop says which square of it to show; without one, delivery takes the center square. The blob size limit matches the reference PDS default, so an image above the app.bsky.actor.profile#avatar limit of 1,000,000 bytes cannot be reused there as is.

license.description: User-declared usage license. Values are placeholders until legal review.

crop.description: Square region of the image to show. Absent means the center square.

purpose.description: What the image is for. A missing value means avatar. Gallery images never resolve as an avatar.

sort.description: Gallery order, lowest first. Images without a value follow, newest first.

crop.description: A square region of the image. Records cannot hold fractions, so each value is an integer in units of 1/10000 of the image (10000 is the whole). Measured on the image as displayed, with any EXIF orientation applied.

x.description: Left edge, as a fraction of the image width.

y.description: Top edge, as a fraction of the image height.

size.description: Side length, as a fraction of the shorter side. 10000 is the whole short side.
